content.text: Summary: Read T-3007, listed kafka pods and found zk-2 in CrashLoopBackOff (epoch-file corruption in logs) alongside healthy zk-0/zk-1, which explains why the PDB (minAvailable:2) refuses to evict zk-0. Confirmed in the docs that drain blocks indefinitely in this case under the default UnhealthyPodEvictionPolicy. Resolved the ticket telling the owner not to bypass the PDB (quorum/data-loss risk on a 3-node ZK ensemble), to recover zk-2 first, and optionally to set `unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy: AlwaysAllow` on the PDB for the future.
